public_rationale: Zitron described generative AI as “so unprofitable” “right now” on July 24, 2024 [wyea-rot-economics-an-interview-with-mits-daron-acemoglu-ce719f-o1]. On July 27, The Decoder reported projected OpenAI losses of up to $5 billion for all of 2024, rather than realized April–June results [e1]. TechCrunch reported on January 6, 2024 that Midjourney was “apparently profitable,” without a profit amount or accounting period [e2]. These reports do not establish substantial aggregate losses or their absence across generative AI providers in April–June 2024, leaving the claim unresolved under the contract's industry-level reading [e1, e2].
limitations: The evidence supplies no comparable realized April–June 2024 revenues and total expenses for a representative set of providers [e1, e2].
A profitable individual provider would not by itself disprove substantial aggregate industry losses; the Midjourney report also predates the target quarter [e2].

The provider-industry scope and April–June period are assessment interpretations. The statement specifies neither an accounting measure nor a numerical loss threshold [wyea-rot-economics-an-interview-with-mits-daron-acemoglu-ce719f-o1].
This assessment addresses profitability, not the accompanying judgment about usefulness.

statement.excerpt: Because right now the thing I've been on about with generative AI is on top of not being super useful, it's so unprofitable.
statement.document_title: Rot Economics - An Interview With MIT's Daron Acemoglu

from_speaker: every report seems to be suggesting it isn't making people money
our_interpretation: The ordinary financial reading concerns generative AI providers' business profitability, including development and operating expenses, rather than revenue growth or customer productivity.
No individual company is named. Treat this as a claim about the provider industry broadly, not a claim solely about OpenAI or a claim that every provider loses money.
The surrounding reference to reports implies an estimate basis. No accounting profit measure or currency is specified.
For the ongoing observation, use April–June 2024, the latest complete quarter before publication.
'So unprofitable' means substantial overall losses; the speaker supplies no numerical materiality threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence for the target quarter shows substantial aggregate losses across a representative set of generative AI providers, with revenues and total costs measured consistently.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence for the target quarter shows the provider industry broadly profitable or without substantial aggregate losses.

evidence.explanation: A reported profitable provider cautions against treating generative AI losses as universal. The report supplies no profit amount or accounting period and cannot decide aggregate profitability in April–June.
